description: Я, Кондрюк Денис Васильович- викладач фізики та астрономії, робототехніки, 3D -моделювання ВСП "Фаховий коледж ЧНУ". Хочу отримати досвід участі в хакатоні, оскільки ще ніколи такого не робив. Тож, сподіваюся отримати приємні враження і корисний досвід від участі. Сподіваюся на активність членів своєї команди.
summary: Project Alpha 12KI is an interactive simulation game that turns complex space mission planning into an engaging, hands-on engineering experience. Designing a real space mission requires balancing competing constraints—such as budget, spacecraft mass, power limits, orbital mechanics, and scientific objectives—which often feel abstract to students. Our solution allows players to design, manage, and simulate a complete mission from concept to operation. Players make critical engineering decisions, allocate limited resources, and immediately see how each trade-off impacts mission success. By gamifying real-world aerospace systems engineering, our project helps students and enthusiasts intuitively understand the physics, logistics, and problem-solving behind actual space exploration.
details: Project Alpha 12KI is an interactive space mission design simulator that challenges players to plan, build, and manage a complete space mission from concept to operation. Players must carefully balance competing engineering constraints—such as budget, spacecraft mass, power consumption, scientific instruments, launch vehicles, and orbital mechanics—while making critical real-time decisions to ensure mission success.
